geometry_notes.trip/Features/Explore/Views/Map/MapToolP: A 400-point ideal width gives the native contextual sheet room for its place actions while preserving the map. SwiftUI fits it to the available window. visionOS uses native split-column sizing.
geometry_notes.trip/Features/Explore/Models/Explore/Pla: The 100-point native compact detent keeps the place title and toolbar reachable. Taller native detents provide scrolling details, and accessibility text excludes the compact detent.
geometry_notes.Packages/TripKit/Sources/TripRouting/Fea: A 350-point ideal width and text-scaled 360-point ideal height keep the native options popover proportionate to its short form. SwiftUI fits the presentation to available space and the form scrolls when needed.

fixed_font.trip/Features/Explore/Views/Markers/Anno: Bounded map annotation metadata; the complete place label is exposed to accessibility.
fixed_font.trip/Features/Explore/Views/Markers/Mark: MapEngine owns the measured annotation footprint and zoom scaling.
Decorative SF Symbol geometry inside a measured annotation.
fixed_font.trip/Features/Explore/Views/Markers/Cate: Decorative SF Symbol scales with its supplied badge diameter.

raw_spacing.trip/Features/Explore/Views/Markers/Rati: Optical spacing between the rating glyph and its value.

raw_inset.trip/Features/Explore/Views/Map/MapCanva: Map attribution and native bottom-control clearance, not content padding.

literal_motion.trip/DesignSystem/AppTheme+Motion.swift: Owns the shared ordinary-control animation recipes.
literal_motion.trip/Features/Explore/Controllers/Galler: Direct image manipulation and gesture settling; Reduce Motion is supplied by the host.
Interruptible gallery paging and dismissal with explicit Reduce Motion input.
literal_motion.trip/Features/Trips/Models/Map/TripMapMo: Map fitting has its own camera duration and caller-provided animation policy.
Map camera updates use the caller-provided animation policy.
literal_motion.Packages/TripKit/Sources/TripRouting/Fea: Independent package owns its presentation animation and observes Reduce Motion.

literal_color.Packages/TripKit/Sources/TripRouting/Fea: Host-injectable route callout fill paired with white text; package cannot access app assets.
